result_text:
I fixed the typos in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I did not add tests for the new matches or check them on sample files. The `Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` ran clean, but they may not cover these rules.

- **Generated HTML (`addGeneratedConventions`):** the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`, which listed `html` twice. They now read `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match too.
- **Generated .NET doc XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file named exactly `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JS (`addBuildAndDeploymentConventions`):** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` required a literal `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The content conditions are unchanged, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope. The old `.html` and `.xhtml` matches still work, and so does the `.gradle` rule.
